heroEyebrow: Published research · product design · AI safety & evaluation
heroTitle: I design the interfaces and engineer the systems that get the most out of AI.
heroBody: I am a published researcher and AI engineer. My experience spans product design, AI/ML research, ed tech, healthcare, and AI safety and evaluation research, and I bring that range into each system I build. I approach products the way I approach research: I start from what a person is trying to get done, define a question that can be measured, design an interface that makes the answer simple to use, and engineer the system and evaluation harness that show whether it works. Working with founders, policy researchers, and cross-functional teams has made me practiced at turning an ambiguous problem into a system people can rely on.

modules.title: What the portfolio demonstrates
modules.markdown: The product dossiers explain the interface, system architecture, implemented workflow, evaluation method, and resulting improvement behind each build. The ML studies document two distinct achievements: a peer-reviewed OpenCV method for measuring brain atrophy and a four-class TensorFlow experiment that improved held-out accuracy through probability-level ensembling.
